name: rexplayer
tagline: Every file, stream and disc. A Windows media player built from scratch.
description:
A Windows media player whose engine is REX code: format readers that recognise media by its bytes, a media session with a single-threaded command mailbox and sample-accurate seeking, its own MP3 and FLAC decoders, gapless playback, and its own resampler and mixer. A WinUI window shows video decoded on the graphics card, with subtitles, an equaliser, playback speed, visualisations, a playlist, full screen and snapshots, and one window takes everything you open. Patented codecs decode through Windows; everything else is written here.

Every line of the engine is covered by tests on each change, including exact-sample checks of what was played, and the window itself is driven through UI Automation in CI.
highlights: Its own engine: format readers, media session, resampler and mixer
Video decoded on the graphics card, straight into the window
Gapless albums, cut to the sample
Every engine line covered by tests, and the window driven by UI Automation in CI
